Lin Tp Requested Mode The requested LIN TP mode. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Function called by Lin TP to request a mode for the corresponding LIN channel. The Lin Tp_ Mode correlates to the LIN schedule table that should be used. Available via Bsw M_ Lin Tp.h
